compound.name: γ-terpinene
compound.one_liner: The cyclic monoterpene from which thyme and oregano build thymol and carvacrol.

biosynthesis.note: Formed from geranyl diphosphate; precursor of thymol and carvacrol [42].

occurrences.source_citation: EMA/HMPC. Assessment report on Thymus vulgaris L., Thymus zygis L., herba. EMA/HMPC/342334/2013 (12 Nov 2013). https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/herbal-report/final-assessment-report-thymus-vulgaris-l-vulgaris-zygis-l-herba_en.pdf
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: EMA lists γ-terpinene among main oil components. | Basis as recorded: ppm as listed by Duke (basis not stated per row; for 'Essent. Oil' parts it is ppm of the oil, 10000 ppm = 1 %)

occurrences.source_citation: De Martino L, De Feo V, Formisano C, Mignola E, Senatore F (2009) Chemical composition and antimicrobial activity of the essential oils from three chemotypes of Origanum vulgare L. ssp. hirtum (Link) Ietswaart growing wild in Campania (Southern Italy). Molecules 14(8):2735-2746
occurrences.database: Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases
occurrences.note: Duke (Lagouri 1993): Shoot max 4950 ppm. De Martino chemotype 2: 4.59 %. Kosakowska 2021: highest of the monoterpene hydrocarbons, % not extracted. | Basis as recorded: % of essential oil

processing_stability.volatility: steam-volatile: recovered in hydro/steam-distilled essential oil (see occurrence sources)
processing_stability.note: Solubility and heat-stability values not sourced in this pass.

compound.teaching_note: The branch point of the phenolic-monoterpene pathway [42].
gaps: No human evidence for the isolated compound found in this pass.
